arguments.group: ecx, signed 32-bit group index; the filter pass calls with 0..count-1
arguments.r8: r8d, element index within the group; read only on the group-0 arm
arguments.rdx: rdx, pointer to the caller's second record (forwarded unchanged as the selector's rcx on the non-zero-group arm)
arguments.rsi: rsi, pointer to the caller's element record (forwarded unchanged as the selector's rdx on the non-zero-group arm)

callees_not_modelled.selector_0x5f6c2a0: called once per non-empty later group with (obj, esi = later group index, rdx = the predicate's rsi, rcx = the predicate's rdx); its return is the predicate's decision for that group. The selector tail-jumps to the 964-byte dispatch 0x5f6a820, whose own semantics are NOT pinned by this item; the model takes selector results as an oracle input

predicate.note: the filter pass 0x5f6d700's site is 0x5f6d7e1; the other site is inside the 0x5da5100 function, which inverts the result (xor $0x1) and is recorded as a site only

selector.note: this predicate's site is 0x5f6d67e; the other three sites are outside this item and are recorded as sites only

object_layout.entries_base: obj+0xa98, pointer to the group-entry array; entry i at base + i*24, fields (begin, end, third qword never read by this predicate)

return_value: 1 means a later group decides against the element (the filter pass skips it); 0 means no later group decides against it (the filter pass appends it)

semantics.group_0_arm: entry 0's element count is ((entry0.end - entry0.begin) as a wrapping signed 64-bit difference, arithmetic-shifted right by 3), taken at 32 bits, minus 1 (32-bit wrap). When r8d != that last index, return 1 at once. When r8d == that last index, the later-groups-empty scan runs: if the signed group count <= 1, return 0; otherwise entries 1..count-1 are scanned in order and any entry with begin != end returns 1 at once; all empty returns 0. A begin-past-end entry is non-empty to this equality test.
semantics.nonzero_group_arm: let next = group + 1 (32-bit wrap, signed). While the signed group count > next: read entry next; if it is empty (begin == end) advance next and continue; otherwise call the selector 0x5f6c2a0 with (obj, esi = next, rdx = the predicate's rsi, rcx = the predicate's rdx); a nonzero selector result returns 1 at once, a zero result advances next and continues. When next reaches the count, return 0. The group count is re-read from obj+0x10 on every loop iteration.

unknowns: The dispatch callee 0x5f6a820's semantics (what makes the selector return nonzero for a later group) are not modelled here; the model treats selector results as oracle inputs.
Whether the selector or dispatch mutates the object (the predicate re-reads the group count each iteration) is not pinned; the model treats the count and entries as stable across one call.
The 0x5da5100 caller's purpose (it inverts the predicate result) is not modelled; it is recorded as a site only.

predicate.identity: later-group predicate: group-0 last-element arm plus later-group selector loop

selector.identity: index selector referenced by the predicate: returns 0 when signed32(obj+0x14) <= index; otherwise picks the inline slot (index*16 + obj+0xb8, index <= 7 unsigned) or the heap slot ((index-8)*16 + obj+0xc0) and tail-jumps to dispatch 0x5f6a820 with (rdi = [obj], rsi = 1 if index > 0 signed else 0, rdx = selected slot, rcx = incoming rdx, r8 = incoming rcx); its own dispatch semantics are NOT re-claimed here
